summary.en: Soft grey tab sidebar, white pages, and an orange marker on the current tab. A calm, colors-only theme. No permissions.
summary.zh_TW: 淡灰分頁側欄、白色網頁，目前分頁有橘色標記。沉穩的純配色主題，不需任何權限。

notes.toolbar: Active tab == toolbar in Chrome, and the toolbar colour also paints the toolbar row, infobars and the frame around web content. Modelled on Firefox's light theme: #F2F2F2 sidebar, #FAFAFA toolbar/frame (sampled from Firefox), white pages, so the active tab is a slightly lighter pill.
notes.marker: The active tab is marked with the theme_toolbar image. Chrome tiles that image from each tab's own top-left corner at 1 image px = 1 device px, but from the window's left edge on the toolbar, so a capsule at image x 1-7 shows on the active tab and stays hidden behind the sidebar on the toolbar. y 14-46 matches the favicon on a 60px (2x) tab. Hovered tabs also show it.
notes.group_chips: Tab-group chip colors are not themeable; a white background_tab makes Chrome use its light group palette.
